3832.title: Touch pointer hover styling
3832.rootCauseOneLine: Unconditional hover styles outrank the compact inset reset, and touch suppression ends at 767px.
3832.proposedFix: Gate hover-only styling on hover capability while retaining keyboard and menu-open behavior.
3832.caveats: Minimal CSS fixture only; forced hover reproduces the cascade, but persistent native tap state in the full app remains unverified.
